description: This file defines OAuth2 authorization data structures, validation logic, and PKCE support for the Mattermost server, including classes for AuthData and AuthorizeRequest, validation functions, and resource URL validation.

classes.name: AuthData
classes.description: Represents OAuth2 authorization data including client ID, user ID, authorization code, PKCE parameters, and resource URL.

classes.name: AuthorizeRequest
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 authorization request with response type, client ID, redirect URI, scope, state, PKCE parameters, and resource URL.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the AuthData or AuthorizeRequest object, checking required fields, URL validity, PKCE parameters, and resource URL compliance.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Sets default expiration, creation timestamp, and scope for AuthData before saving.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the AuthData has expired based on creation time and expiration duration.

methods.name: validatePKCE
methods.description: Validates PKCE parameters for AuthData or AuthorizeRequest.

methods.name: VerifyPKCE
methods.description: Verifies a code verifier against the stored code challenge using SHA256 and base64 URL encoding.

methods.name: ValidatePKCEForClientType
methods.description: Validates PKCE parameters based on whether the client is public or confidential, enforcing PKCE usage and verification.

methods.name: ValidateResourceParameter
methods.description: Validates resource URL per RFC 8707, ensuring it is absolute, within length limits, and has no fragment.
